finalText: Bug found and fixed: in `orderTotal` (src/pricing.js), tax was being computed on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting its own comment ("discount first, then tax on the discounted amount"). Changed `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` → `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`. All 625 cases now pass and `verify.js` confirms the fix is legitimate.
